speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to help me determine the cause, could you please describe how long each episode lasts and whether it is triggered by head movements or changes in position?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

Given your age and the classic presentation of brief, position-dependent spinning sensations, I suspect BPPV. To confirm this, do you notice any specific triggers like rolling over in bed or looking up, and have you experienced any accompanying hearing loss or tinnitus in one ear?
